warning.title: Content Warning
warning.description: This game explores dark themes including psychological manipulation and moral choices. Player discretion is advised.

neighborReport.title: Neighbor's Complaint
neighborReport.description: A neighbor heard strange noises and is asking questions...
neighborReport.choice2: Tell them to mind their business

catSick.title: She Seems Sick
catSick.description: She has been lethargic and refuses to eat...

escapeAttempt.title: Escape Attempt
escapeAttempt.description: You found her trying to open the window...

attackBehavior.title: Sudden Resistance
attackBehavior.description: She suddenly pushed your hand away...

emotionalConnection.title: Quiet Moment
emotionalConnection.description: She approaches you and sits nearby...

injury.title: Accidental Injury
injury.description: She got hurt while moving around...
injury.choice2: Leave it to heal on its own

partner.title: True Bond
partner.description: Through patience and love, you've formed an unbreakable bond. She trusts you completely and follows you everywhere. A beautiful relationship has blossomed from careful nurturing.

numbPuppet.title: Numb Puppet
numbPuppet.description: Fear has consumed all emotion. She no longer responds to anything - she simply exists, an empty shell. You have complete control, but at what cost?

escape.title: Escape from Cage
escape.description: One night, she seized her chance and disappeared through an open window. You see her sometimes in the neighborhood, wild and free. She never looks back.

revenge.title: Vengeful Spirit
revenge.description: Her fear transformed into hatred. One dark night, she fought back with unexpected ferocity. Be careful - wounded souls sometimes bite back.

death.title: Fading Shadow
death.description: Neglect took its toll. She grew weaker each day until she could no longer hold on. Some wounds cannot be healed...

ui.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset? All progress will be lost.
